title_as_printed: Solubilities, fugacities, and Henry's constants for gases dissolved in light and heavy water.
footnotes_as_printed: not captured (no footnotes in table; the continuation on the right of p. 1080 continues Ar-D2O and the D2O blocks)
pressure_note: total equilibrium cell pressure in the cell (gas + solvent vapour), measured with Bourdon gauges; column P

value2.unit: ln of Henry constant kH in GPa, kH = y phi2 P / x (Eq. 5), gamma2 in Henry reference state taken as 1
value2.note: calculated by the authors from measured x with literature virial coefficients; kH is a derived value

composition.other_species: none (pure H2O, or D2O in skipped blocks)

skip_rows.reason: solvent D2O (heavy water), not in scope

extra_unmapped: y (gas-phase mole fraction of solute, calculated by authors from Eq. 2; water mole fraction in gas = 1 - y)
conversion_needs: x is the mole fraction of dissolved gas at the total pressure P (not at fixed partial pressure)
notes: Blocks are stacked, one label row per gas-solvent block; only CH4-H2O block mapped. Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe blocks and all D2O blocks are kept in the CSV but skipped. Gas partial pressure = y*P (approx) is derivable from y. Temperature probe calibrated on IPTS 68.
